updateNotes.v2.0.0:
**__HUGE UPDATE!!!__**

Introducing Genshin Impact Integration! Check-In and Code Redemption will now be compatible with Genshin Impact accounts. Rejoice!

**__UPDATED COMMANDS__**

`/checkin`: Checks you in for both Honkai Star Rail and Genshin Impact!

`/redeem code [code] [game (Honkai Star Rail/Genshin Impact)]`: Now requires a game argument to redeem a code.

`/redeem all`: Now redeems all codes for both Genshin Impact and Honkai Star Rail.

**__AUTO-FUNCTIONS__**

**Daily Check-In**: Now checks in for both Genshin Impact and Honkai Star Rail!

**Global Code Redeem**: Now redeems codes for everyone for both Genshin Impact and Honkai Star Rail!

**__NOTES__**

You will need to have both Genshin Impact and Honkai Star Rail accounts linked to *one* HoyoVese account, otherwise you will only get check-in/code redeems for 1 account. Multi HoyoVerse accounts are not supported as of now.
updateNotes.v1.3.0:
Hi Guys, a new update has appeared! From now on, every major update will come with new update notes to inform users about new changes.

**__NEW COMMANDS__**

`/redeem code` **ADMINS ONLY**: Redeems a code for you and the rest of the userbase!

`/redeem all`: Redeems *all* the available codes for you. This may take a while.

`/silent`: Hate the constant daily check-in and code redeem notifs? Use this command to turn them off! Running `/silent` again will turn them back on.
